evidence_status_definitions.VERIFIED: Direct authoritative evidence from official source supports the full claim (e.g., government statistics, regulatory documents)
evidence_status_definitions.SUPPORTED: Credible evidence from 2+ independent sources supports most/all of claim, with minimal limitations
evidence_status_definitions.DOCUMENTED: Claim is present in internal or external authoritative document, but not independently verified
evidence_status_definitions.ESTIMATED: Value results from declared calculation with sourced inputs; methodology explicit
evidence_status_definitions.INFERRED: Logical conclusion from documented evidence with explicit rationale; not direct measurement
evidence_status_definitions.PLANNED: Future intention stated as planning document; not current reality
evidence_status_definitions.ASSUMED: Working assumption explicitly requiring validation; confidence <0.6
evidence_status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Insufficient evidence to evaluate; research needed
evidence_status_definitions.CONFLICT: Credible sources or internal data disagree materially
evidence_status_definitions.BLOCKED: Verification blocked by missing dependency or required decision
evidence_status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Claim category does not apply to this context
evidence_status_definitions.STALE: Evidence too old for current claim; measurement year discrepancy
evidence_status_definitions.REJECTED: Claim is false, irreconcilable with evidence, or methodologically invalid
